mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the country's total output of final goods and services in real terms rather than in money terms."
Real national income refers to the country's total output of final goods and services in real terms rather than in money terms.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the question of how a society can organize itself to ensure equality of opportunity and equity (social and economic justice) for all citizens."
Good governance refers to the question of how a society can organize itself to ensure equality of opportunity and equity (social and economic justice) for all citizens.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation where resources are not fully utilized."
Unemployment is a situation where resources are not fully utilized.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the take-off, through which developing countries are expected to transit from an underdeveloped to a developed state."
The decisive stage is the take-off, through which developing countries are expected to transit from an underdeveloped to a developed state.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the low level of per capita income of a country."
Poverty simply refers to the low level of per capita income of a country.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the allocation of resources in terms of men, materials and machinery."
Physical planning refers to the allocation of resources in terms of men, materials and machinery.
fib: ______ is concerned with the increase in per capita income and the causes behind this increase.
Economic development is concerned with the increase in per capita income and the causes behind this increase.
______ is an entrepreneur, creativity of the masses by 2025 b.
Everyone is an entrepreneur, creativity of the masses by 2025 b.
______ is an economic system where decisions regarding production and investment are embodied in a plan formulated by Gosplan (State planning agency) through the process of material balances.

The Soviet model of economic planning is an economic system where decisions regarding production and investment are embodied in a plan formulated by Gosplan (State planning agency) through the process of material balances.
______ are those whose values are determined from within the system, examples of such are national income, consumption, savings, investment etc.
Endogenous variables are those whose values are determined from within the system, examples of such are national income, consumption, savings, investment etc.
______ is known to produce food for households, raw materials for industries and foreign earnings for the government when exported abroad.
The agricultural sector is known to produce food for households, raw materials for industries and foreign earnings for the government when exported abroad.
